name: mac-mcp
description: Local MCP server for the macOS ecosystem — Reminders via EventKit

scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p dist && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 helper/main.swift -o dist/mac-helper -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker helper/Info.plist
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/e2e.mjs
scripts.inspect: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node dist/index.js
